messages:
maria: Hey team — PR #4123 (migration-guide) is green locally but failing docs CI in preview. Vale flagged an abbrev rule on a quoted customer name. cc @josh for context.

ci-bot: docs-preview failed: vale/abbrev rule (docs/migrations/guide.md:42)

Error: rule 'abbrev' triggered on "Gov" (pattern: [A-Z][a-z]{1,3})
File: docs/migrations/guide.md:42
Context: > "API Gov. is now deprecated..."

josh: Ack. Vale v2 is stricter. We can either reword or add an inline ignore around the quoted line.

amy: What's the merge window for this week? I thought we had an 11:30 PT slot today.

maria: Prefer not to reword — it's a verbatim customer quote. Suggest using a local vale disable for the quote block:

<!-- vale-disable abbrev -->
> "API Gov. is now deprecated..."
<!-- vale-enable abbrev -->

kevin: That's fine, but please add a one-line comment explaining why (audit trail). Last time docs reviewers asked for that. e.g. "intentional capitalization to match original customer quote".

josh: Sounds good. @maria can you push that and then trigger a CI rerun? `/gh pr checks rerun` usually works.

maria: Pushed the vale-disable block + comment and a small note in the PR description. Link: https://github.com/redwood/pr/4123

ci-bot: Rerun started for PR #4123 (mergeable: unknown)...

ci-bot: Vale check OK now. Linkcheck: warning - preview URL 404 for staging asset (assets/img/migration-diagram.png), but that's a stale staging path (works in prod).

ci-bot: Spellcheck: flagged 'load-balancer' (docs/snippets/setup.md:10) - hyphenation rule.

amy: Odd, spellcheck has been flaky about hyphenation. I can push a microfix (change to 'load balancer') unless someone thinks hyphen is required.

maria: The snippet is from an installer script; hyphen might break code block parsing. Go ahead, change to 'load balancer' in prose and keep code as-is.

amy: Pushed tiny change and rebased against main to pick up the latest md-lint config.

ci-bot: Re-run complete: vale ✅, linkcheck ✅ (staging asset 404 ignored due to static-asset whitelist), spellcheck ✅. All checks passed. :tada:

josh: Great — I'll schedule for the 11:30 PT merge slot. If anything else pops up, ping here.

maria: Thanks all. PR description updated: "Fixed Vale false positive for quoted customer name; resolved spellcheck hyphenation. Ready for merge slot." :shipit:

docs-bot: Merge queued for 11:30 PT window by @josh.

josh: Merged at 11:33 PT — closed PR #4123. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
